# CatastrophicForgettingMitigation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Techniques used during continual learning to prevent the overwriting of previously learned action representations when new action classes are introduced. Critical for deploying neuromorphic systems that must accumulate knowledge over time without retraining, a key challenge for autonomous in-network agents.
